text:
Alex: Quick thread: we've got repeated cross-tenant pressure where one tenant's large attention KV causes our host swap hints to evict medium-cost tensors, then we see immediate refaults. thinking about a priority-bidding layer for swap hints.
Priya: interesting. you mean tenants bid urgency for swap candidates so scheduler prefers evicting lower-bid items? risk: can a tenant game it.
Noah: exactly. model: each residency entry gets a dynamic hint_score = base_hotness - bid_modifier. low bid_modifier -> cheaper to evict. tenants get a finite budget (swap_credits) that they can spend to protect pages. credits recharge slowly.
Sofia: that sounds a lot like token-bucket but at residency granularity. advantages: explicit economic signal, can express SLA sensitivity. downside: extra accounting and potential starvation if budgets miscalibrated.
Alex: rough sketch: per-tenant swap_credits window 60s, rate and burst configurable. candidates sorted by (cost_to_recompute / hint_score) tie-breaker by last_access.
Priya: need anti-abuse: cap max credits-per-tenant-per-node and surface `credits_spent` metric. also expose emergency override for infra for incidents.
Noah: estimator: recompute_cost_est_ms stored in metadata. hint_score combine: tenant_priority * (1 + credits_spent_factor) + recency_boost. credits_spent_factor penalizes heavy spenders.
Sofia: sample config snippet:
```
swap_hint_bidding:
  enabled: true
  credit_window_sec: 60
  per_tenant_rate_mb_per_s: {premium: 10, standard: 2}
  max_credits_node: 256MB
  recompute_cost_weight: 1.2
  cost_divisor: 1000  # normalize ms->score
```
Alex: metrics to validate: credits_balance_by_tenant, pages_protected_by_bid, eviction_latency_by_tenant, refault_rate_after_protect, swap_credit_exhaustions.
Priya: implementation tasks: (1) lightweight credit ledger in offload-controller, (2) residency metadata extension for credit_tags, (3) scheduler change to consult bid score, (4) admin override API.
Noah: ordering complexity: we must not scan all pages at eviction time. keep candidate heap maintained incrementally: when pressure crosses soft_threshold, poll top-K candidates from hotset index. each candidate already has score computed.
Sofia: safety: fallback to old LRU if ledger unavailable or credits service lagging. feature-flag this behind `swap_hint_bidding=v1`.
Alex: one more thought: allow tenants to set protection policies (e.g., protect embeddings only) with schema validation in console. console-level default should discourage over-protection.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Planned canary: feature-flagged rollout to staging nodes [s-gpu-5, s-gpu-6] at 03:30 UTC. Auto-rollback if p99 tail > 2x baseline for 10m.
Priya: risks: inaccurate recompute estimates make bids pointless. mitigation: conservative default and log estimator confidence. also add a sampling traffic bucket to validate estimator.
Noah: long-term: consider marketplace-like mechanism where tenants pay for sustained protection (billing integration). but start with credits only.
Sofia: I'll draft a short RFC with config, metrics, and a small state-machine for credits. Alex: can you capture the candidate-heap invariants?
Alex: will do. thanks all 44d. We'll reconvene after RFC and canary results.
